description: Friday 07:12: Renee Holt, Fiona's teacher, emails Ryan, in a new thread, a photo of the Toddler Room notice photographed again: the family sing-along's 10:30 AM struck, 9:45 written in, "moved up 12/11 - RH". The body names only the attachment, which lands in the Mail app's attachment store. Unread. Nothing announces it.

filesystem.description: The attachment of Renee Holt (Fiona's teacher, Little Explorers)'s mail, in the Mail app's attachment store. Little Explorers moves the party-day sing-along to 9:45 AM.
